# Alibre STL to STEP Importer

- The STL to STEP Importer turns an STL mesh into a STEP solid and imports it, so you can work with a downloaded mesh as ordinary Alibre geometry.
  - What it does
    - Adds an STL Importer menu with a single Import STL File command.
    - Lets you pick an STL file from your computer.
    - Converts that file to STEP using a bundled converter.
    - Imports the converted file into the session you have open.
    - Tells you whether the conversion worked, and reports the error if it did not.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design, with the add-on assemblies that ship with your install.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime on 64-bit Windows.
    - Visual Studio or MSBuild if you want to build it yourself.
  - Getting started
    - Build `source/alibre-stltostp.sln` in Release configuration.
    - Copy the build output into your Alibre Design add-ons directory.
    - Keep the add-on, the converter, the icon, and the manifest together in that folder, because the add-on looks for the converter beside itself.
    - Start Alibre Design and choose STL Importer, then Import STL File.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the C# add-on, the manifest, and the bundled converter.
    - `documentation/` holds reference notes.
  - Good to know
    - The slugdev project wrote the bundled `stltostp.exe` converter, which carries its own BSD licence.
    - Conversion quality depends on that converter, so a very large or damaged mesh can fail.
  - Use it under the MIT License.
